info.name: Grocery List API
info.description:
Requests and automated tests for the grocery list REST API.

Run the **grocery_list** folder with **Run folder** (order matters: "Create item - valid" saves `itemId`, then PUT/DELETE use it). The destructive folder deletes every item and is meant to be run separately.

Requires the backend on http://localhost:3000 and the MySQL container (`docker compose up -d`).
